name: comic-agent-client
description: AI 漫剧 Agent Electron 客户端

scripts.test: node scripts/build-test-cache.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types --import ./scripts/test-loader.mjs --test src/main/*.test.mts src/renderer/*.test.mts src/renderer/components/*.test.mts src/renderer/services/*.test.mts src/renderer/stores/*.test.mts scripts/*.test.mts
scripts.test:all: pnpm run test && pnpm run test:server
scripts.build:local: pnpm run build:runtime && vite build && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.build: pnpm run build:web && vite build && electron-builder
scripts.electron:dev: concurrently "cd ../server && python main.py" "vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 http://127.0.0.1:8011/health && electron ."
